findings.title: The sudoers installer rule permits root execution of a user-writable script
findings.description: `MT_INSTALL` authorizes root to run the installer from `/home/manta/source/repos/manta/trading-data`, the operator’s checkout. Because that checkout is writable by the `manta` account, the account can modify the authorized script and then invoke it through `sudo` to execute arbitrary code as root. The installer must be installed from a root-owned, non-writable location, or this sudoers grant must be removed or otherwise constrained.

findings.title: The bounded cutover firing still waits for the entire minute pass
findings.description: `fire_unit_until` calls `mt-run minute` synchronously before it starts polling the journal. But `deploy/mt-run`’s `start_and_stream` waits in a loop until the systemd unit is no longer active. Consequently, the cutover cannot stop the unit when the trailing-completion line appears; it waits for the unbounded backfill to finish first. Start the unit in a way that returns control promptly, then poll for the marker and stop it.

findings.title: Sessions with only an out-of-session spillover bar are not marked for reseeding
findings.description: The truncation scan only returns a day when it finds at least one bar inside that session (`bars.newest IS NOT NULL`) and that bar is at or before the open. The reported failure case has only a midnight spillover bar, outside the session interval, so this scan excludes the session entirely. The same truncated-day detection is used by the universe index builder. Since the cagg can still mark that calendar day covered by the spillover bar, the daemon’s new uncovered-day seeding will not necessarily recreate the missing session’s gap. Include sessions with no in-session bars when determining which covered days require repair.
